paragraphs.notes: Whole page body is a single un-numbered continuation of the Markush substituent definition list that runs across pages 9 to 12 of the printed patent. WO A1 publications carry no [00NN] paragraph markers, so marker is null. The list starts mid-sentence: the first item on this page continues the enumeration begun on the previous page, and the page ends on a comma, continuing onto printed page 11 (PDF p13), whose first item is Cycloalkenylalkenyloxycarbonyl. LINE-BREAK REJOINING: three printed lines break inside a term and have been rejoined at the hyphen with no space inserted, because in every other occurrence on the page the same term is printed with that hyphen: 'Alkenylsulfonyl N-Alkyl-' + 'amino', 'Heteroarylalkylsulfonyl-N-' + 'alkyl-amino', 'Heteroarylalkenylsulfonyl-N-alkyl-' + 'amino'. No other change was made to the printed text. TWO IRREGULARITIES READ AS PRINTED AND DELIBERATELY NOT CORRECTED. (1) 'Alkenylsulfonyl N-Alkyl-amino' is printed with a SPACE where every neighbouring term has a hyphen ('Alkylsulfonyl-N-alkyl-amino', 'Alkinylsulfonyl-N-Alkyl-amino'). Verified at 2x: there is white space and no dash glyph between 'Alkenylsulfonyl' and 'N-Alkyl-'. (2) 'Arylalkylsulfonyl-amino' is printed WITHOUT the 'N-alkyl' that every other item in this sub-series carries; verified at 2x. Its position in the series (between Heteroarylsulfonyl-N-alkyl-amino and Heteroarylalkylsulfonyl-N-alkyl-amino, in a run of N-alkyl-amino terms) suggests the intended term is Arylalkylsulfonyl-N-alkyl-amino, but the characters are absent from the page and have not been supplied. CASE VARIES AS PRINTED: the patent switches between '-N-alkyl-amino' and '-N-Alkyl-amino' within the same series (lower-case from Cycloalkylalkinylsulfonyl onward, capitalised before it). Transcribed exactly as printed. The en field is a translation, not a copy: these are GERMAN group names, and German 'Alkinyl' is English 'alkynyl' throughout. German noun capitalisation is dropped in en. The two irregularities above are carried through into en unchanged.
